title: Blood Resonance
next_chapter_hook: That ancient summoning from the deepest part of the ruins grows increasingly clear, as if some existence that has slumbered for ten thousand years is awakening—and it seems to recognize every strand of qi flowing within Chen Ji's bloodline.

text.content: Passing through that gorgeous radiant transport gate, Chen Ji felt a sudden pressure surge around his body, as if millions of jin of water was pressing down on all his limbs and bones simultaneously. The scenery of the second layer of the secret realm slowly revealed itself—this was scorched earth burned by war, with shattered spirit stone remnants scattered everywhere. In the sky hung a dark red crescent moon, dyeing the entire space with a layer of blood color. The spiritual energy in the air was savage and chaotic, each breath carrying a burning pain. From the distance came bursts of rumbling, mixed with the roars of human cultivators and the howls of strange beasts. Chen Ji restrained his aura and concealed himself behind a massive broken rock. He did not rush to act; instead, he pressed his right hand against his chest—where the Tianji Record was quaking with unprecedented intensity, as if something was calling to it. Mo Xiansheng's weakened soul's voice rang in his mind: 'The second layer... the Tianji Record's aura has been captured by something.'

At this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's embrace suddenly became scalding hot. Alarmed, he immediately used spiritual energy to insulate the heat, yet he watched as the fragment unfolded on its own. On what was originally the blank second page, dense silver runes emerged. Those runes resembled tadpoles, winding and circling, constantly shifting positions—this was no random scribble, but some extremely ancient formation pattern. Chen Ji had never seen such runes, but strangely, when his gaze fell upon them, he felt an inexplicable sense of familiarity, as if something deep within his blood was responding. 'This is... Bloodline Formation Pattern?' Mo Xiansheng's voice abruptly rose, 'Impossible! This is something that only the rightful inheritor of the Tianji Record can activate—you've never studied this, so why would it...' Before he could finish, those silver runes transformed into a streak of flowing light, shooting directly into Chen Ji's brow center. In an instant, countless scenes flashed through his mind like a carousel: a vast starry sea, a collapsed altar, a blurry figure...

dialogue.content: Steady your mind! This blood resonance is opening your memory seal—don't resist, let it flow through!

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, allowing those fragmented images to wash over his consciousness. A moment later, everything returned to calm. He opened his eyes to find a faint golden border faintly appearing around his pupils—that was the mark left by the bloodline formation pattern. The Tianji Record's second page closed again, but the landscape painting on the cover seemed slightly clearer, with a towering tower faintly visible standing among the clouds. Before Chen Ji could examine it closely, dense footsteps and spiritual energy fluctuations suddenly came from ahead. He held his breath and peered through the gap in the broken rocks—a group of more than a dozen cultivators was rushing toward this direction. The leader wore the Xuanwu Sect's signature black combat attire, his figure built like an iron tower, his face as cold as ice. It was his old rival, Xuanwu Sect's number one genius Han Lie! And behind Han Lie followed several demonic cultivators with cold, sinister auras. The leader wore a purple-black gauze robe—it was Ye Qing. The alliance of two major forces—this lineup was clearly here for a cleanup.

choice.prompt: All factions gathered, and the risk of Chen Ji's identity being exposed suddenly skyrocketed. At this moment he needed to make a choice—

choices.description: Completely restrain all aura, hide in the shadows to observe the movements of all parties. Use secret techniques to briefly conceal the Tianji Record's fluctuations, waiting for the right moment.
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily escape danger, can continue observing the situation
choices.risk_hint: Limited number of concealment talismans, may not have another next time

text.content: Chen Ji took out a yellowed talisman from his storage bag—this was one of the trump cards he had laid out in his early years. The moment the talisman was activated, his form became illusory like he was blending into shadows, his aura suppressed to the extreme. He silently glided into a nearby crevice, his back against the cold rock wall, quietly observing the approaching crowd.

choices.description: Appear voluntarily, infiltrate the crowd disguised as a Tianqing Sect servant disciple. Utilize the subtle balance between various forces, seek opportunities in the gaps.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence, secretly communicate with Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's hatred for Chen Ji remains unquenched, once recognized he will attack on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, concealing all his edge, hunched his back and stumbled out from behind the broken rock, wearing an expression of panic. 'B-Brothers, please save me!' he shouted, his voice carrying just the right amount of trembling, 'I am a servant disciple of Tianqing Sect, I entered this place by mistake, please brothers take me along!'

choices.description: Utilize the Tianji Record's foresight ability to capture Han Lie and others' weaknesses, create chaos before they notice, and delve deeper into the ruins' core amid the confusion.
choices.visible_reward: Foresee key information, can precisely control the situation
choices.risk_hint: Excessive Heavenly Fate consumption will affect subsequent arrangements

text.content: Chen Ji quietly activated the Tianji Record, an invisible perception spreading forward. Within three breaths, scenes from the next three hours flashed through his mind like a carousel—he saw Han Lie's furious face, Ye Qing's meaningful gaze, and also the golden glowing altar entrance deep within the ruins. An ambush was waiting for him, but the exit's location was also faintly visible in the corner of his foresight.

Chen Ji chose to endure and lie in wait, his form sliding into the rock crevice like a ghost. The talisman's concealment effect was in full force, compressing his aura to the extreme. However, just as he believed himself safe, a cold voice suddenly exploded in his ear — "Come out, trash of the Tianqing Sect." Han Lie had somehow stopped in his tracks, those tiger eyes glaring死死 at the direction where Chen Ji was hiding, a cruel arc curving at the corner of his mouth. "You thought hiding behind a rock would prevent me from smelling that nauseating stench on you?" He approached slowly, each step stirring violent spiritual energy fluctuations. "Last time in the scripture repository I let you escape. This time... luck won't be on your side." Chen Ji's heart sank. The concealment talisman could hide his aura but couldn't sever the karmic thread connecting him and Han Lie. This lunatic's hatred had deepened to the point where he could lock onto Chen Ji's position even through the talisman.

dialogue.content: What? Scared witless? Can't even speak? The number one servant disciple of the entire Tianqing Sect, reduced to this by just my words — hahahaha! Trash is indeed trash!

text.content: Han Lie's laughter echoed across this scorched earth, sharp and arrogant. Several nearby Xuanwu Sect disciples joined in the mockery, their gazes filled with contempt. Chen Ji slowly emerged from the rock crevice, his face wearing perfectly timed fear, but deep within those eyes was a sheet of ice. He silently memorized every mocking face — Han Lie, the Xuanwu Sect disciples, and those demonic path cultivators. When today's business concluded, he would settle these accounts one by one. At that moment, a clear, cold voice suddenly interjected: "Han Senior Brother, why bother making things difficult for a servant disciple?" Everyone turned to look. Ye Qing walked forward gracefully, those purple eyes pausing briefly on Chen Ji, a hint of something extraordinary flickering in their depths. "The formations at the秘境 core region require several experts working together to break. Though this废物 is useless, he'd be suitable for scouting ahead." She said indifferently, "Killing him would be a waste."

dialogue.content: Besides, the dangers of the second layer of this secret realm are no laughing matter. Having one more person to share the risks is better than one less, wouldn't you say?

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's intervention bought Chen Ji a moment to catch his breath, but Han Lie's killing intent showed no signs of diminishing. Chen Ji had to make a choice —

choices.description: Follow the situation naturally, play the role of a cowardly, death-fearing废物, follow the group's movements. Secretly seek opportunities to break away.
choices.visible_reward: Safely follow to the relic core area
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie may regret his decision at any moment

text.content: "Yes yes yes! Thank you, Senior Sister, for saving my life!" Chen Ji repeatedly bowed, his posture humble to the extreme, the perfect picture of a coward whose胆 had been completely shattered. He stood at the very end of the group with lowered eyes, yet with his peripheral vision he took in everyone's positions. Han Lie coldly snorted, saying nothing more, but the occasional killing intent flashing in those tiger eyes felt like thorns on his back. Ye Qing seemed to casually walk beside him, but in truth she was不动声色ly blocking some of the more hostile gazes.

choices.description: Use secret techniques while walking to transmit signals to Ye Qing, confirming their cooperative relationship, agreeing to coordinate actions at critical moments.
choices.visible_reward: Establish a secret alliance with Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: Demonic path methods are easily exposed

text.content: Taking advantage of the group's movement, Chen Ji quietly circulated his spiritual energy, injecting a trace of information into the dust beneath his feet — that was their previously agreed-upon signal. Ye Qing's footsteps slightly paused, then returned to normal. Moments later, a message only Chen Ji could perceive arrived quietly: "There's an ambush three hundred zhang ahead, and a hidden passage on the left cliff. Later I'll create chaos, and you take that chance to slip away." Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but warmth blossomed in his heart. This demonic path saint truly was his lucky star.

choices.description: Deliberately say some stimulating words to provoke Han Lie, making him humiliate himself publicly, thereby weakening the Xuanwu Sect's voice in the alliance.
choices.visible_cost: Han Lie may attack on the spot
choices.visible_reward: Dissolve the alliance relationship, creating an opportunity for Ye Qing to act
choices.risk_hint: Under the combat power gap, may be seriously injured

text.content: "Han Senior Brother is mighty!" Chen Ji suddenly shouted loudly, his tone carrying deliberate flattery, "Last time at the scripture repository, thanks to Senior Brother's merciful hand, this lowly one managed to keep one little命. Senior Brother can rest assured, this time this one will definitely obey orders obediently and won't dare the slightest bit of defiance!" These words were spoken with genuine emotion, but anyone with sharp eyes could hear the sarcastic undertone. Han Lie's face instantly turned ashen, killing intent暴涨 in those tiger eyes: "What did you say?!" Chen Ji, however, acted as if scared, shrinking his neck, his voice even smaller: "This、this lowly one was merely speaking the truth... could this lowly one be wrong?" The surrounding atmosphere suddenly tensed, and several Xuanwu Sect disciples' expressions became quite interesting.

Just as the atmosphere reached a剑拔弩张 state, the earth beneath their feet suddenly trembled violently. A desolate and ancient bell sound came drifting from deep within the relic, as if traversing endless years, stirring layers of ripples in the soul of every person. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply — that bell sound carried some indescribable power, frantically pulling at the Tianji Record at his chest. At the same time, his blood seemed to ignite, boiling and roaring through his blood vessels, a tremor from deep within his bloodline making him nearly unable to control himself. That wasn't simple resonance, but some kind of summons — as if some existence that had slumbered for endless years was calling his name from the deepest part of the relic. "This is..." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly grew grave, "A Heavenly Fate bloodline summons! Chen Ji, your identity... I'm afraid it can no longer be hidden!"

dialogue.content: What kind of sound?! Could there be living creatures within this relic?!

text.content: Han Lie turned sharply, his gaze sweeping the surroundings warily. The mournful bell toll continued, each resonance causing those present to change color—the power within that sound was by no means ordinary mechanism could produce. However, what they didn't know was that the true being summoned was the waste servant disciple in their eyes. Chen Ji clenched his teeth, forcibly enduring the boiling sensation in his blood. His body was uncontrollably tilting toward the depths of the ruins, as if an invisible thread was pulling at his heart, tightening and tightening further. The burning sensation in his chest grew increasingly intense, the cover of the Tianji Record had become scorching hot, almost scorching his skin. What was worse, he faintly sensed—that the source of the summoning seemed to be "confirming" his existence in some way. It wasn't simple attraction, but a recognition across bloodlines. As if something, deep within the ruins, was using ancient methods to verify his identity again and again.

Ye Qing's gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a moment, a flash of understanding passing through those purple eyes. She walked slowly to Chen Ji's side, whispering in a voice only the two of them could hear: "Do you feel it? The source of that summoning..." She paused, her tone carrying rare solemnity, "That is the tomb of the second master of the Tianji Record. And according to the Holy Sect's records, the second master... had the surname Chen." Chen Ji shuddered all over, raising his head to look at Ye Qing. Their eyes met in the air, without need for more words, each already knowing the other's mind. Deep within these ruins lay the inescapable past of his bloodline. And he had to make a choice—whether to passively wait for the disaster of exposure, or actively walk toward that summoning, using the chips in his hand to place a crucial piece on fate's scale.

choice.prompt: The ancient summoning grew increasingly intense, the sense of destiny in his bloodline making Chen Ji almost unable to resist. He had to make a choice—

choices.description: Follow the summoning's pull, rushing into the ruins' depths before others could react. Take a gamble—arrive at the tomb first and seize the advantage.
choices.visible_cost: "Completely expose one's whereabouts, possibly inviting encirclement"
choices.visible_reward: "Arrive at the tomb first and obtain clues to bloodline inheritance"
choices.risk_hint: "Go deeper alone, with enemies front and back"

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer. He abruptly broke free from the pulling sensation, his form becoming a blur as he shot toward the ruins' depths. "That waste is running!" Han Lie roared, about to give chase, but was silently blocked by Ye Qing standing in his path. "Han Senior Brother, that bell sound is strange. Rashly pursuing would likely lead to traps." Her voice was light, but her tone carried undeniable firmness. Han Lie's expression turned dark as water, yet he had to temporarily suppress his impulse to pursue—the dangers in the ruins' depths were obviously far more important than one waste.

choices.description: Signal Ye Qing to create chaos and draw attention away, while I quietly slip away from the group and infiltrate the ruins' core through a hidden passage.
choices.visible_cost: "Deplete one instance of coordinated timing with Ye Qing"
choices.risk_hint: "If exposed, Ye Qing would be in great danger"

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze met Ye Qing's in the air. In that instant, the two reached an understanding. Ye Qing suddenly clutched her chest, her face turning pale as she stumbled back two steps: "This isn't good... there's a mind-controlling evil technique in that bell sound. I need to circulate my energy to resist!" Her voice carried just the right amount of weakness, drawing the attention of those around her. In that moment of chaos, Chen Ji silently slipped into the shadows, moving soundlessly along the hidden passage Ye Qing had indicated earlier. He glanced back to see Ye Qing watching him leave with peripheral vision, her lips moving silently to speak two words: "Be careful."

choices.description: Forcibly suppress the bloodline's restlessness and continue playing the role of a waste servant disciple, moving with the main group. Look for a safer opportunity to infiltrate.
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve the disguise and seek other opportunities within the group"
choices.risk_hint: "The bloodline reaction might be noticed by others"

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth tightly, forcibly suppressing the boiling urge. His face turned deathly pale, fine beads of cold sweat appearing on his forehead, the whole person swaying as if about to collapse at any moment. "What's wrong with this waste?" a Xuanwu Sect disciple frowned and asked. Han Lie glanced coldly, sneering: "Just a waste, scared out of his wits by the bell. Don't bother with him. Dead would be best." Chen Ji lowered his head, the corners of his mouth slightly rising—being treated as a waste was actually his best cover at this moment. Though the burning sensation from his bloodline was tormenting him, at least his identity hadn't been exposed yet. As long as he remained in this group, he would have opportunities to find better timing.

However, Chen Ji's disguise didn't last long. When the group reached the edge of a massive rift, that summoning suddenly turned violent, as if something below the rift had sensed his presence and was frantically tearing at his soul. Chen Ji's foot slipped, his whole body involuntarily rushing toward the rift's edge—his body had stopped obeying him! That was the instinct of bloodline, the destiny etched into his very bones. "What's... what's happening?!" Those around finally noticed something was wrong. Han Lie narrowed his eyes, staring at Chen Ji's unusual behavior, a hint of suspicion flashing in his gaze. And at that moment, an ancient and majestic voice suddenly came from the depths of the rift: "Chen... descendant... return..." The voice thundered through the entire secret realm. Everyone's expression changed—Chen? That ancient family that had declined ten thousand years ago? And this waste servant disciple before their eyes was actually connected to that legendary family?

dialogue.content: "Chen family?! Are you a Chen family descendant?!"

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. He knew his identity could no longer be hidden. That ancient voice from the rift's depths continued calling to him, each word branding itself into the depths of his soul like a branding iron, irresistible, impossible to ignore. Ye Qing's complex gaze fell upon him, a flash of understanding and concern in those purple eyes. She knew that from this moment on, Chen Ji would no longer be that obscure waste servant disciple—he was a Chen family descendant, an approved candidate for inheritance recognized by the ruins' core. This meant he would become the target of everyone: the Xuanwu Sect, other sects, even the Holy Sect behind her. No one would let slip away an inheritance candidate who might possess ancient secret treasures. And below the rift, that ancient call continued, as if urging him to take the final step: "Return... Chen... descendant... return..."
